[[Category:Recipes for paninis]]
This panini is the ultimate sandwich with grilled sliced ribeye, smoky and salty bacon, and creamy, nutty, Gruyere cheese.

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (12–16 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] / 400–500 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]]) [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]] ribeye steaks
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground black [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
* White [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]], sliced ½ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] thick
* Extra-virgin [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* Shredded [[Cookbook:Gruyère Cheese|Gruyere]] cheese
* Several slices cooked [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]]

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] steaks with extra-virgin olive oil. Sprinkle liberally with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
#[[Cookbook:Grilling|Grill]] steaks, covered, over medium high heat, turning often, until your desired "doneness" is achieved (145°F for medium rare, 155°F for medium well, and 165°F for toast).
#Remove and let rest 10 minutes. [[Cookbook:Slicing|Slice]] thinly across the grain on a bias. Set aside.
#Brush both sides of bread with extra-virgin olive oil. Layer some shredded cheese on the bottom, then 4 strips steak, then some bacon, some more cheese, then one more slice bread. Repeat until all meat is used up.
#Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat for 4–5 minutes. Add sandwiches and cook until browned on both sides and cheese is melted. Serve warm.

Remove and let rest 10 minutes. Slice thinly across the grain on a bias. Set aside.
